cases.sentence: Весной, когда цари идут на войну, Давид послал Иава со своими приближенными и всем израильским ___.
cases.translation: In the spring, when kings go out to war, David sent Joab with his officials and all Israel's army.
cases.explain: The instrumental case marks the entity sent together with someone (the preposition со meaning 'with').

cases.sentence: Однажды вечером Давид вошел во дворец и прогуливался по крыше ___.
cases.translation: One evening David entered the palace and walked on the roof of his palace.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession (the roof of the palace).

cases.sentence: С крыши он увидел женщину, которая была очень красива, и Давид послал разузнать о ___.
cases.translation: From the roof he saw a woman who was very beautiful, and David sent to inquire about her.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Это Версавия, дочь Елеама и жена хетта ___.
cases.translation: This is Bathsheba, daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession (wife of Uriah).

cases.sentence: Тогда Давид отправил Иаву приказ. «Пришли ко мне хетта ___».
cases.translation: Then David sent word to Joab, 'Send me Uriah the Hittite.'
cases.explain: The accusative case marks the direct object of the imperative verb пришли.

cases.sentence: Урия лег спать у входа во дворец со всеми слугами своего ___ и не пошел к себе домой.
cases.translation: Uriah slept at the entrance of the palace with all his master's servants and did not go home.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession (his master's servants).

cases.sentence: Когда Давиду сказали, «Урия не пошел домой», он спросил его, «Разве ты не после дороги? Почему ты не пошел домой?» Урия сказал Давиду, «Ковчег, Израиль и Иуда находятся в шатрах, и мой господин Иоав и все люди моего ___ находятся в открытом поле».
cases.translation: When they told David, 'Uriah did not go home,' David asked him, 'Haven't you just come from a journey? Why didn't you go home?' Uriah said to David, 'The ark, Israel, and Judah are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and my lord's men are camped in the open field.'
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession (my lord's men).

cases.sentence: Давид сказал ему, «Оставайся здесь и сегодня, а завтра я отправлю тебя обратно» и тогда Давид напоил его ___.
cases.translation: David said to him, 'Stay here today as well, and tomorrow I will send you back,' and then David made him drunk with wine.
cases.explain: The instrumental case marks what someone is made drunk with.

reading.ru: Весной, когда цари идут на войну, Давид послал Иава со своими приближенными и всем израильским войском, и они нанесли поражение аманитянам и осадили их главный город Равву.
reading.question: What did David's army do to the Ammonites?
options: Defeated them and besieged their capital city Rabbah
Made a peace treaty with them
reading.correct: Defeated them and besieged their capital city Rabbah
reading.explain: The text states that they defeated the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah, their main city.

reading.ru: Однажды вечером, поднявшись с постели, Давид прогуливался по крыше своего дворца, с крыши он увидел купающуюся женщину.
reading.question: What did David see from his palace roof?
reading.explain: The text explicitly says David saw a woman bathing from his palace roof.

reading.ru: Посланный сказал, «Это Версавия, дочь Елеама и жена Хетта Урии».
reading.question: Who was Bathsheba?
options: Daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite
reading.correct: Daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite
reading.explain: David's messenger tells him that the woman is Bathsheba, daughter of Eliam and wife of the Hittite Uriah.

reading.ru: Урия сказал Давиду, «Ковчег, Израиль и Иуда находятся в шатрах, и мой господин Иоав и все люди моего господина находятся в открытом поле. Как же я могу пойти домой, чтобы есть, пить и спать со своей женой?»
reading.question: Why did Uriah refuse to go home?
options: Because the ark and the army were in the field, so he could not enjoy comforts at home
Because he was angry with his wife
Because he didn't want to leave the battle
Because David ordered him not to
reading.correct: Because the ark and the army were in the field, so he could not enjoy comforts at home
reading.explain: Uriah explained that since the ark and Israel's forces were in the field, he would not go home to eat, drink, and sleep in comfort.

reading.ru: Но Урия лег спать у входа во дворец со всеми слугами своего господина и не пошел к себе домой.
reading.question: Where did Uriah sleep instead of going home?
options: At the entrance of the palace with his master's other servants
reading.correct: At the entrance of the palace with his master's other servants
reading.explain: Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, refusing to go home.

reading.ru: Когда жена Урии услышала, что ее муж погиб, она оплакивала его.
reading.question: How did Bathsheba respond to Uriah's death?
reading.explain: When Bathsheba heard that her husband Uriah had died, she mourned for him.
